room_rent.note: Optional downgrade to Single Private Room available

sub_limits.note: All covers up to Sum Insured

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (12 or 24 months with optional cover)

cumulative_bonus.note: Plus Benefit adds 50% of Base SI each renewal, up to 100%. No separate cumulative bonus.

restoration.note: Once a year, 100% of Base SI, triggers on partial or complete exhaustion; usable for the same or a different illness.

consumables.note: Protect Benefit covers non-medical/consumable expenses; inbuilt by default

notable_exclusions: Maternity, congenital external anomalies, stem cell harvesting, cosmetic surgery, OPD treatment, hearing aids/spectacles
optional_riders: Aggregate deductible, Emergency Air Ambulance (inbuilt up to ₹5L), Daily Cash for Shared Room, PED wait modification, Room Rent modification (Single Private room), Critical Illness add-on, Parenthood
source_note: Built from the Annexure C plan chart column 'Optima Secure': Secure Benefit 100% of Base SI, Plus Benefit 50%/yr up to 100%, Automatic Restore 100% once, Protect Benefit inbuilt (removable), room and ICU at actuals.
